title: K-Shaped Economy: Why the Rich Feel Great and You Feel Broke
alts: The Top 10% Own 88% of Stocks. That's Why You Feel Broke.
Same Economy, Two Lives: The K-Shaped Economy Explained
line1: What is the K-shaped economy? Since 2020 stocks are up 138% and homes 59%, while rent and groceries ate your raise. Here's why.
summary: Dave and his rich neighbor Richie live on the same street, in the same economy, and feel completely different about it. We explain where the K-shape came from in 2020, why asset owners rode the up arm while renters ran in place, who really owns America's stocks (Fed data), the wealth effect and why the top 10% drive about half of spending, rising credit card and auto delinquencies at the bottom, why averages lie (Bill Gates walks into a bar), both sides of the political debate, and how Dave can move toward the upper arm.
